mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across market cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (the current level) despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in unemployment signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5 and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals industrial sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a further decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and FEDFUNDS declines.
